t: In front of you is a statue of Robert Burns, the poet widely regarded as the national poet of Scotland and celebrated around the world. He is the best known of the writers who used the Scots language, though he also wrote in standard English, where his political and civil commentary can be at its bluntest. The statue was made by John Steell, a Scottish sculptor who modelled many leading figures of Scottish history and culture. He is best known for his Edinburgh work, including the statue of Sir Walter Scott at the foot of the Scott Monument.
